channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Badminton Weekly Round-Up: Big Wins, Cup Finalists & One More League Push
item.description: This week’s results as our teams picked up key league wins, a vital draw, and multiple cup victories to reach the final. Next week is the final league round before playoffs—every match matters.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.description: Celebrating our Grade 1 Interleague team's runners-up medal at the Badminton Ireland Grade C Final.
